verdict.rationale: v0 has no documented native background automations, scheduled jobs, or event-triggered autonomous runs. Its auto-fix features (Fix Build, Fix CI, Fix Conflicts) only run when the user selects them. The closest support is the Platform API and SDK, which let you drive v0 programmatically (e.g. v0.chats.create) from your own workflows. That means you would have to build and host the automation yourself. Missing for 10: native scheduled or triggered automations, autonomous background execution without user initiation, and docs or hands-on evidence of unattended runs.
